manualChecklist.instruction: Using real mouse input in the installed editor, inspect the advertised animation capability descriptors, request and result schemas, declared limits, generation contracts, mutability, approval policies, and durable-job behavior. Cross-check the scripted asset import/reimport/inspect, controller edit/validation, advanced authoring, preview, runtime parameter, procedural, retarget, motion-match, ragdoll, recording, diagnostics, residency, profiler, camera, and job get/cancel evidence against the corresponding editor windows. Deliberately approve the exact high-impact animation import, reimport, motion-database build, recording start, and recording stop requests, and retain the approval UI receipts and native-window screenshots. Do not use project create/open/close/switch or application lifecycle operations.

Using real keyboard input, verify the scripted exact retry replays one receipt, the changed-payload retry conflicts without publication, the dry-run leaves authored bytes unchanged, and the stale-generation request rejects atomically. While the durable animation import, reimport, motion-database build, successful recording, and canceled recording jobs remain retained, disconnect and reconnect MCP, rediscover the same required animation tool inventory, poll the original job IDs and correlated diagnostics from the new connection, and verify the cancellation result remains unpublished. Exercise Play Mode and Scene/Game/custom-camera review, then exit and prove authored scene state restores while the two explicitly declared recording output files remain as the only allowed Play Mode project additions. Performance timing is intentionally deferred because the power-limited host cannot produce comparable regression measurements.
